limits: Activation overhead only; dormant probe branches, allocation and native-key lookup remain in A. This is not pristine upstream or the installed executable.
No exclusive GPU occupancy claim from interval unions/spans; timestamps can perturb ordering.
Same input durations can drift camera/position; each scene must be read before accepting comparison.
GPU observer polls every6s, cannot exclude work entirely between polls. No GPU fdinfo counters read.
Two raw video/audio subscribers preserve encoding/subscriptions; results do not qualify browser playback or all locations.
Only full600-return windows inside explicit phase bounds; partial coverage. Quantiles remain per window.
Native WSI accepted returns are not unique guest frames or physical scanout. Nonzero PCM/scheduled playback is not physical AV sync.
B may retain a silent running AudioContext; zero app game PCM played is the qualified condition.
All reviewed static views retain the same camera and position; particles, idle animations and wall-time startup phase still vary. No movement or new-zone qualification.
scope: Static Kokiri camera calibration only; same manual-enabled ELF, capture unarmed/armed A/B/A/B. Not a movement or new-zone performance comparison.
conclusion: Capture activation delta changes sign (-1.40%, +1.52%); overhead unresolved against variation. No systematic cadence regression demonstrated, no transparency or uninstrumented GPU-budget claim.

analysis_correction.scope: Offline reader correction only; every pretrial frozen input and original analysis script retained unchanged. Active/native execution proved with available bounded captures; inactive twin must produce none.
